title: ListEmailRecipientSource - Data API
description: For a list email in Salesforce, represents the dynamically defined sources of recipient email addresses. Each record represents a link to a single list view or campaign that is examined when the list email is sent. Has a one-to-many relationship with ListEmail. This object is available in API version 41.0 and later.

ListEmailId.description: The related list email record. Required on record creation; read-only otherwise. This is a relationship field.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The auto-generated name of the list email recipient source.

SourceListId.description: The id of a list view to send the list email to. Read-only except when list email is in draft state. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

SourceType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
SourceType.description: Read-only except when list email is in draft state. Valid values: Include
